name: cfcmt-bus-native-terminal-continuation-v1

training_settings.model_stop_role: stop only; choose within fixed fitting iterations
training_settings.model_calibrate_role: diagnostics only; no controller or family selection
training_settings.source_arrival_rate_feature: Omitted in all source state slots because causal historical arrivals cannot be recovered; target observed arrivals retained
training_settings.checkpoint_rule: Fixed final controller checkpoint, with no evaluation-based selection
training_settings.continuation_backup: Existing H2O+ mixed backup: 0.1 value + 0.9 SAC, with online_fraction=0 and ratio correction disabled; actual and synthetic branches share it.

fixed_kernel: Original free_execution_actor recipe: real/synthetic H2O+ critic backup0.1V+0.9Q without alpha; recorded IQL actor with collapsed-state weights zero and unchanged batchN; original temperature update retained.
model_generation_and_trust: All arms keep the same model generation, trust update path and RNG. real ignores model loss only via coefficient0. uniform calls native generation then replaces only TD weights by ones; confidence preserves native weights.
confidence_definition: Frozen native trust: tau starts1e-3 and is updated by EMA0.9tau+0.1median(error) with median floor1e-8; c=1/(1+error/tau). QDelta uses normalized Bellman target(1-gamma_delta)*log(c)+gamma_delta*(1-done)*QDelta(next), gamma_delta0.9; native weight exponentiates learned log confidence. This is distinct from passenger critic gamma1 and per-batch sum-to-one or mean-matched weights.
comparison_boundary: wm_confidence vs wm_uniform changes the actual confidence weighting, including its effective model-loss magnitude, at the same nominal coefficient0.25; not a ranking-only intervention.
checkpoint_rule: Every arm loads the same seed-matched repaired final55k adapted.pt with complete optimizers, then fixed final20k. Stored learner counters5000->25000; historical55000->75000. No model, checkpoint, seed or threshold selection.

evaluation.test_separation: Reuse already analyzed72571-72573/73571-73573, disjoint from train/stop/calibrate; not new prospective confirmation
evaluation.comparison: 27 new evaluations, plus existing repaired55k nine and rule three
evaluation.completion: Report completion rate and departed/completed counts alongside cost.
evaluation.interpretation: Bounded pilot on one target city; no population-level CI or city removal.

admission: Separate seed75101 fresh learners, four actual updates per arm. Verify real corrected terminal targets with actual continuation backup, matching initial real/model batch identities, confidence preservation and uniform ones; no simulation or model/checkpoint writes.
budget: Nine fixed20k CPU continuations180000 total updates plus27 full-day evaluations; reuse9 adapted and3 actual heuristic runs. All39 actual evaluations retained, equal seed/case weighting.
reporting: Report all seed/case costs, wait/ride, completion/counts and native model-weight diagnostics. No population CI, cherry picking, pooling old demand cohorts or city removal.
interpretation: Conditional continuation diagnostic on already analyzed Halifax72571-72573 demand cases. real continuation and55k stage reference differ in update count and critic/actor recipe; confidence-vs-uniform is the matched weighting test. No physical sim-to-real or cross-city population claim.
code_boundary: New CFCMT-owned isolated worker and frozen settings only; no mutable Thesis access, shared helper edits or heavy local downloads.
model_loss_formula: Bootstrap probability1 uses mean(weight * elementwise Huber delta1), with original batch/ensemble denominator. Synthetic coefficient0.25 in both WM arms; uniform weights1, confidence native exp(QDelta). There is no sum(weight) division.
